devdoc.details: - `ftUSD` is treated as USD with 6 decimals. - Collateral is deposited as principal into a per-collateral `ftYieldWrapper` (single-asset wrapper). - Mint-side conversions and reserve accounting use `oracle.priceUSD(collateral)`, optionally capped by   `mintPriceHardcapWad`. - Redeem-side conversions use a conservative scalar: oracle price below par, reciprocal above par. - Exposes mint/redeem plus session-key (delegated) flows for integrators.

proxiableUUID().details: Implementation of the ERC-1822 {proxiableUUID} function. This returns the storage slot used by the implementation. It is used to validate the implementation's compatibility when performing an upgrade. IMPORTANT: A proxy pointing at a proxiable contract should not be considered proxiable itself, because this risks bricking a proxy that upgrades to it, by delegating to itself until out of gas. Thus it is critical that this function revert if invoked through a proxy. This is guaranteed by the `notDelegated` modifier.

pause().notice: Pauses all minting and redemption operations.

assetsUSD().notice: Returns the total system assets valued in ftUSD units (6 decimals).

MIN_TVL_FLOOR().notice: Minimum allowed value for minTVLForMint (500K ftUSD)

sweepFees(address,uint256).notice: Sweeps collected ftUSD fees (held by this contract) to a destination address.

previewMint(address,uint256).notice: Previews the ftUSD amount that would be received for a given collateral deposit.

setRedeemFee(address,uint16).notice: Sets the redeem fee for a specific collateral token.

redeemPriceBreakdown(address).notice: Returns the current redeem factor decomposition for a collateral.

previewRedeem(address,uint256).notice: Previews the collateral amount that would be received for a given ftUSD redemption.

sweepExcess(address,address,uint256).notice: Sweeps excess collateral above the reserve requirement to a destination address.

mint(address,uint256,uint256,uint256).notice: Mints ftUSD by depositing collateral, sending to the caller.

recoverERC20(address,address,uint256).notice: Recovers accidentally sent ERC20 tokens that are not ftUSD, collateral, or wrapper shares.

setCollateralCapFtUSD(address,uint256).notice: Sets the maximum USD value (in ftUSD units) of a collateral that can be held.

redeem(address,uint256,uint256,uint256).notice: Redeems ftUSD for collateral, sending to the caller.

mintTo(address,address,uint256,bytes32,u.notice: Mints ftUSD by depositing collateral, sending to a specified recipient.

redeemTo(address,address,uint256,bytes32.notice: Redeems ftUSD for collateral, sending to a specified recipient.

mintExactTo(address,address,uint256,byte.notice: Mints an exact ftUSD amount by depositing collateral, sending ftUSD to a recipient.

redeemExactTo(address,address,uint256,by.notice: Redeems an exact collateral amount by burning ftUSD, sending collateral to a recipient.

mintWithSessionAndPermit(address,uint256.notice: Mints ftUSD using a delegated session key and an optional EIP-2612 permit for collateral.

redeemWithSessionAndPermit(address,uint2.notice: Redeems ftUSD using a delegated session key and an optional EIP-2612 permit for ftUSD.

mintExactWithSessionAndPermit(address,ui.notice: Mints an exact ftUSD amount (net to the owner) using a delegated session key.

redeemExactWithSessionAndPermit(address,.notice: Redeems an exact collateral amount (net to the owner) using a delegated session key.

Independent grants, policies, pauses and canonical calldata/value controls remain mandatory; zero native value required.

Ethereum ftUSD MintAndRedeem proxy only, current observed implementation 0x8852b132b72613a16f1e3960978a3d45c0a7c3c6. Official address book lists both proxy and implementation; product API selects proxy. UUPS ownership and dependencies remain mutable. Point-in-time paused() read was false, not a continuing availability guarantee.

Plain mint/redeem methods pull only msg.sender funds. To variants can direct output to a nonzero recipient, without transferring another payer authority. bytes32 ref is event metadata, not executable calldata. Session/permit/signature flows, relayer authority, token transfers, owner operations and upgrades are excluded.

ftUSD amounts use 6 decimals; collateral amounts use configured native token decimals. Mint exact-input floors oracle conversion; mint exact-output rounds required input and gross fee up. Redeem exact-input floors collateral output after fee; redeem exact-output rounds required ftUSD and gross fee up. Transaction deadlines and caller output minima/input maxima apply.

Only registered enabled collateral can be used. Mint deposits caller collateral into its configured yield wrapper and invokes immutable core mint; fee is retained in ftUSD. Mint price may be hard-capped, collateral caps and oracle price apply. Redemption uses conservative spot/average-mint factors, not unconditional 1:1 redemption; fees and mutable oracle/wrapper behavior matter.

Circuit breakers can queue minted ftUSD recipient transfers; the mint return amount does not guarantee immediate receipt. Redemption burns net ftUSD then asks configured wrapper to withdraw collateral to recipient, potentially returning a queue ID.
